name: figma-node-inspector
description: Figma plugin: inspect selection tree, serialize layout/styles, smart image bake, export JSON/HTML/ZIP
author: 杜豪

scripts.docs:json-schema: node -e "import {getNodeJsonSchemaDoc,getNodeJsonSchemaDocFilename} from './scripts/lib/node-json-schema-doc.mjs'; import fs from 'fs'; fs.mkdirSync('docs',{recursive:true}); const f='docs/'+getNodeJsonSchemaDocFilename('node-json'); fs.writeFileSync(f, getNodeJsonSchemaDoc()); console.log('wrote', f)"
scripts.test:mcp: node scripts/test-mcp-check.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-protocol.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-images.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-e2e.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-stdio.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:bridge && npm run test:mcp
